final: SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation sc2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = sc2.zoneref) AS fraction_of_matched_records FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction_of_matched_records DESC, (s.insurstat IS NULL) ASC LIMIT 10
